newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tingyi sees noodle sales up in 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Tingyi sees noodle sales up in 2nd half.

text.p: Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp said on Wednesday the sales volume of its instant noodle products in the second half of the year could be higher than in the first half.

"Owing to the low-high seasonal sales fluctuation of our instant noodle products, the ratio of the sales volume of instant noodle products of the first half year to that of the second half, based on our experience, would be an estimate of approximately 4 to 6," the company said in a statement.
However, the comapny said the ratio did not represent an estimate of profit for the second half of the year.
"This ratio is not reviewed by the auditors," it added.
Earlier this week, Tingyi said it had total sales of US$228.01 million for the six month to June 30, with net profit of US$35.69 million.
Tingyi shares were down HK$0.07 to HK$1.67 around midday.
